series.label: LTV vs cost-to-serve per connected pump

derivation.method: per-pump ARR and cost rates over active sites × 5-year undiscounted horizon; ratio = Σ ARR ÷ Σ cost_to_serve on raw sums (horizon cancels), rounded for display only

points.label: cost-to-serve per pump over the same horizon

series.label: ARR vs cost-to-serve per pump by site size

derivation.method: per size band over active sites: Σ ARR ÷ Σ pumps and Σ cost_to_serve ÷ Σ pumps

series.label: Mean hardware discount by site size

derivation.method: simple mean of hardware_discount_pct across active subscribed sites, per band and overall

series.label: E-04.2 threshold sensitivity — miss vs sampling noise

derivation.method: margin = raw mean hardware_discount_pct − tolerance; SE = sample standard deviation (n−1) ÷ √n over active sites; knife-edge flagged when |margin| ≤ 1pp or |margin| ≤ 2 × SE
sites with >= 1 connected device in the fleet registry minus sites present in the subscription register

series.label: ARR build from active-site start dates ($K, survivor-biased)

derivation.method: cumulative current ARR of active sites by subscription start month — churned sites' past ARR absent (survivor bias stated)

provenance.note: one register snapshot exists — unit-economics history accumulates as recurring snapshots land; a single point is not a trend

verdicts.headline: Unit economics fail the guardrail: LTV per connected pump $2,237 vs $2,720 cost-to-serve over the same 5-year horizon (ratio 0.82 vs the 3.0 floor); 28 of 39 active sites run ARR below cost-to-serve — concentrated in small sites — and the mean hardware discount at subscribed sites is 5.8% vs the 5% tolerance

issues.statement: Small sites are negative at unit level: 24 sites (<= 6 pumps) run $460/pump/yr below water (24 of them ARR-below-cost individually)
issues.action: Set a minimum-deal-size or platform-fee floor for new subscriptions; review the serve model (remote-first) for the existing small-site tail

issues.statement: Mean hardware discount at subscribed sites is 5.8%, over the 5% tolerance — the subscription may be being bought with hardware price
issues.action: Pull deal-level pricing for subscribed vs unsubscribed sites; without an unsubscribed baseline in the corpus, causality stays unproven either way

risks.statement: Fleet-wide LTV:cost-to-serve is 0.82, under the 3.0 floor — and the LTV side is flattered by the model (no churn decrement, no discounting) while 3 churned sites already exist
risks.mitigation: Fix the cost side (serve model) before growing the small-site tail; re-underwrite the floor once a churn-adjusted LTV is possible

watch.statement: Attach gap: 4 connected sites carry no subscription (S-APAC-08, S-EMEA-08, S-EMEA-13, S-NA-21) — expansion revenue that needs no new hardware
Churn on file: 3 of 42 register rows (7.1%) — direct evidence that the no-churn 5-year horizon overstates LTV

E-04.2 is a knife-edge: the mean hardware discount misses the 5% stand-in tolerance by +0.8pp on an n=39 mean (SE ≈ 0.4pp; the miss is 2.1 standard errors from the line; flagged on |miss| ≤ 1pp) — the verdict is fragile to the unvalidated stand-in threshold choice; treat it as a watch signal, not a breach finding, until pricing policy sets a real cap

expectations.statement: Lifetime value per connected pump covers cost-to-serve at a healthy multiple
expectations.basis: generic SaaS unit-economics heuristic; no underwritten target
expectations.actual: ratio 0.82 (ARR $447/pump/yr vs cost $544/pump/yr, active sites; ratio computed on raw sums, rounded for display)

expectations.statement: Cloud Suite attach does not erode hardware pricing beyond tolerance
expectations.expected: avg hardware discount at subscribed sites <= 5%
expectations.basis: stand-in tolerance; pricing policy sets no explicit cap
expectations.actual: mean hardware discount 5.8% across 39 active subscribed sites — +0.8pp vs the 5% stand-in line; KNIFE-EDGE on |miss| ≤ 1pp (miss = 2.1 SE, SE ≈ 0.4pp, n=39) against an unvalidated threshold — verdict fragile to the stand-in choice
